title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI推出Businesses in ChatGPT测试版。商家可通过Business Hub认领与维护资料，提交包含价格和库存的产品信息；Business Agents先向美国符合条件的电商和在线服务商开放。ChatGPT正从回答用户问题延伸到承载商家主动维护的信息与交互，商业发现入口的竞争由搜索排序
investorNote: 哪些商家能拿到可量化的转化，仍需后续观察。

evidence.quote: We’re introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, giving businesses a new way to connect with the 1.2 billion people who use ChatGPT each week.
In addition, we are adding a powerful new way for businesses to interact with users via Business Agents, starting with eligible ecommerce and online service businesses in the U.S.
In Business Hub, companies can claim their organization in ChatGPT and, once verified, update key details and add self-service product feeds with pricing and availability.
Business Agents are now available to eligible ecommerce and online service businesses in the United States .

displayTitle: OpenAI推出ChatGPT商家资料与品牌Agent测试版
narrative: OpenAI推出Businesses in ChatGPT测试版。商家可通过Business Hub认领与维护资料，提交包含价格和库存的产品信息；Business Agents先向美国符合条件的电商和在线服务商开放。ChatGPT正从回答用户问题延伸到承载商家主动维护的信息与交互，商业发现入口的竞争由搜索排序走向可管理的资料和对话。哪些商家能拿到可量化的转化，仍需后续观察。
